reason: In pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77, the patch changes CleanUpService.Run's ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute, causing all eight cleanup jobs in clean (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:88-105) to run 10x as often. Because clean retains a 9-minute timeout (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:89) and time.Ticker buffers a tick while srv.clean executes (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:78-85), any run taking longer than a minute immediately triggers the next run back-to-back.
